business_summary: Super Micro Computer, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, develops and sells server and storage solutions based on modular and open-standard architecture in the United States, Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company offers liquid and air-cooled AI servers for training and inferencing with integrated graphics processing units (GPUs) or PCIe based architectures; SuperBlade, MicroBlade, FlexTwin, GrandTwin, and BigTwin blade and multi-node systems; SuperStorage systems; Hyper, CloudDC, and WIO and rackmount systems; embedded (5G/IoT/Edge) systems; and MicroCloud server systems. It also provides workstations and networking devices; and modular server subsystems and accessories, including server boards, chassis, power supplies, and other accessories. In addition, the company offers remote system management solutions, such as Server Management suite comprising Supermicro Server Manager, Supermicro Power Management software, Supermicro Update Manager, SuperCloud Composer, SuperCloud Director, and SuperDoctor 5. Further, the company identifies service requirements; creates and executes project plans; conducts verification testing; offers training; and provides technical documentation. Additionally, it provides rack level services from design to deployment for full rack and cluster level deployments of AI and HPC datacenters; help desk services and on-site product support; and warranties, maintenance, and technical support services. The company serves enterprise data centers, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, 5G, and edge computing markets through direct and indirect sales force, distributors, value-added resellers, system integrators, and original equipment manufacturers. Super Micro Computer, Inc. was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.

SuperBlade, MicroBlade, FlexTwin, GrandTwin, BigTwin 블레이드 및 다중 노드 시스템; 슈퍼스토리지 시스템; Hyper, CloudDC, WIO 및 랙마운트 시스템; 임베디드(5G/IoT/Edge) 시스템; 및 MicroCloud 서버 시스템. 또한 워크스테이션과 네트워킹 장치도 제공합니다. 서버 보드, 섀시, 전원 공급 장치 및 기타 액세서리를 포함한 모듈식 서버 하위 시스템 및 액세서리. 또한 회사는 Supermicro Server Manager, Supermicro Power Management 소프트웨어, Supermicro Update Manager, SuperCloud Composer, SuperCloud Director 및 SuperDoctor 5로 구성된 서버 관리 제품군과 같은 원격 시스템 관리 솔루션을 제공합니다. 또한 회사는 서비스 요구 사항을 식별합니다. 프로젝트 계획을 수립하고 실행합니다. 검증 테스트를 수행합니다. 교육을 제공합니다. 기술 문서를 제공합니다.
